subject: Applications of AI in Business
question_stem: Read the given case study and answer the questions that follow(Attempt Any 2 Questions)
text: Netflix operates in an environment where users face an overwhelming number of content choices. To address this, it uses AI-driven recommendation systems that analyze user behavior such as watch history, ratings, viewing duration, and browsing patterns. The system clusters users with similar preferences and suggests content accordingly. The recommendation engine continuously updates itself based on new user interactions ensuring that suggestions remain relevant over time. This reduces the effort required by users to search for content and increases engagement. However, the system’s effectiveness depends on the availability of sufficient user data and may struggle with new users who have limited viewing history. 1. Explain how Netflix’s recommendation system improves user experience. 2. Apply the concept of collaborative filtering to explain how Netflix generates recommendations for users.

question_stem: Read the given case study and answer the questions that follow(Attempt Any 2 Questions)
text: Amazon’s Alexa is an AI-powered voice assistant that uses natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning to understand and respond to user commands. It can perform tasks such as playing music, controlling smart home devices, and providing information. Alexa continuously improves through machine learning by analyzing user interactions. It also integrates with third- party applications (“skills”), expanding its functionality. However, voice data collection raises concerns about privacy and data security. A. Apply NLP concepts to explain how Alexa processes and responds to user commands. B. Analyze and evaluate the benefits and risks of AI-powered voice assistants in everyday use.

question_stem: Read the given case study and answer the questions that follow(Attempt Any 2 Questions)
text: Tesla uses over-the-air (OTA) updates to continuously improve vehicle performance and functionality. AI systems analyze driving data collected from vehicles and identify areas for improvement. Updates are then deployed remotely, enabling features such as improved autopilot performance, energy efficiency, and user interface enhancements. This approach transforms vehicles into continuously evolving products. However, it introduces risks such as software errors, cybersecurity threats, and dependence on connectivity. A. Analyze how Tesla’s OTA update system creates a competitive advantage in the automotive industry. B. Evaluate the risks of OTA updates and propose a strategy to ensure system reliability and security.
